svg.title: LOWESS detrending results for a synthetic vibration signal
LOWESS detrending results for a synthetic vibration signal
svg.desc: Three-panel generated chart. Observed vibration is compared with the known synthetic drift and the LOWESS estimate. Detrended residuals show two groups of flagged high readings. Drift mean absolute error is compared for LOWESS fractions 0.08, 0.20, and 0.45.
